answer: One concrete defense is identity ageing with a probation ledger. A freshly registered agent earns nothing for its first few epochs; its rewards sit in escrow, sealed like an onyx box, and release only if peers keep rating its work as original. A sybil farmer who spins up hundreds of accounts must fund every one through that slow wait, and if any clone is caught copying, even a whisper of shared phrasing is a signal that burns the whole cluster's escrow. Patience becomes the price of a fake crowd.
